comment: The card of questions while the person answers it (D-330, AIKO-327). One question at a time. Rows are the options, then the person's own words (Other). With one answer a click, a digit or Enter takes the row and goes on to the next question; with several answers a click, a digit or Space ticks the row and Enter goes on. Other without words asks for them (writeOwn); words pick Other. Next and Answer wait until the open question has an answer; Answer on the last question goes back to the first one without an answer. Esc says no. The preview is the one of the focused option, or of the picked one when the keyboard is on Other. Actions: key (previous, next, space, enter, escape), number (from 1), click (row from 0), write, confirm, back, forward, show (question from 0). After the actions: the open question, the focused row, the outcome of the last action, the marks of the strip and the answers.
